lines.text: Why would a car ramp that holds 25000 pounds still be a death trap?
He crushes eleven brands in a press and the 60 dollar plastic ramps take almost 25000 pounds.
That's almost eight times their rating because the plastic ribs spread the load like a honeycomb.
Meanwhile a pair of steel ramps folds under a tractor.
Because thin steel buckles once it starts to bend while the ribs keep sharing the load.
So crushing is the one thing you don't need to worry about.
On smooth concrete almost every ramp slides and two shoot out from under a car.
That's friction because a climbing or braking tire shoves the ramp forward and one rubber stop can't hold it.
A damp towel underneath adds grip and helped most of them which is a free fix anyone can do.
So check for grip and set the parking brake before you crawl under.
So is your car ramp a death trap?
